screen: Sheets, alerts and the transient undo bar (TGActionSheet / TGAlertView / TGSnackbar)

findings.ours: TGActionSheet.m:50 forces `self.actionSheetStyle = UIActionSheetStyleDefault;`, so every sheet renders in the light silver/blue iOS 6 style.
findings.theirs: The original never assigns actionSheetStyle anywhere - every UIActionSheet is left at UIActionSheetStyleAutomatic - and the app forces a black status bar at launch, so Automatic resolves to the black-translucent sheet chrome. All 2013 sheets were dark.
findings.citation: Telegraph/Telegraph/TGAppDelegate.mm:209 `[(TGApplication *)application forceSetStatusBarStyle:UIStatusBarStyleBlackTranslucent animated:false];` plus TGProfileController.m:3032, TGLoginProfileController.m:473/489, TGNotificationSettingsController.m:669 - none of which set actionSheetStyle.
findings.fix: Delete line 50 of src/TGActionSheet.m (leave the style at UIActionSheetStyleAutomatic), or set it explicitly to UIActionSheetStyleBlackTranslucent.

findings.ours: Sheets raised from tab-rooted controllers are shown with `showInView:self.view` (TGChatListViewController.m:844, TGContactsViewController.m:514/635 fall back to the nav view, TGChatEventsViewController.m:1175, TGGroupMembersViewController.m:459). Only TGChatListViewController.m:1837 uses showFromTabBar:. TGActionSheet offers no presentation helper, so each caller improvises.
findings.theirs: The original always checked for a tab bar controller and presented into its view, so the sheet's cancel button sits flush on the screen bottom and the dimming covers the tab bar rather than leaving a 49pt strip.
findings.citation: Telegraph/Telegraph/TGProfileController.m:2993-2996 `if ([self.parentViewController isKindOfClass:[UITabBarController class]]) [_currentActionSheet showInView:self.parentViewController.view]; else [_currentActionSheet showInView:self.view];` (same idiom at :3035-3037, :4544-4546, :5150-5152)
findings.fix: Add a `- (void)showFromController:(UIViewController *)controller` to TGActionSheet that reproduces the original test: present into `controller.parentViewController.view` when that parent is a UITabBarController, otherwise `controller.view`; point all call sites at it.

findings.ours: TGSnackbar.m:188-190 centres the Undo button as `(int)((kBarHeight - kButtonHeight) / 2) + retinaPixel` = 11.5pt from the top of the 55pt plate.
findings.theirs: The original centres the action-bar buttons on the same art with an extra one-point nudge: `(int)((_baseInputContainerHeight - forwardButtonImage.size.height) / 2) + 1 + retinaPixel`.
findings.fix: In src/TGSnackbar.m:189 change the y term to `(int)((kBarHeight - kButtonHeight) / 2) + 1 + retinaPixel`.

findings.ours: TGAlertView.m:54 injects a hardcoded `[self addButtonWithTitle:@"OK"]` when no buttons were supplied; TGActionSheet.m:38 falls back to a literal @"Cancel"; TGSnackbar.m:173 defaults the message to @"Done" and :207 hardcodes @"Undo".
findings.theirs: Every button title in the original comes from the string table - `TGLocalized(@"Common.OK")`, `NSLocalizedString(@"Common.Cancel", nil)`, `Common.Done` - never a bare literal in code.
findings.fix: Route these through the localized keys: `Common.OK` in TGAlertView.m:54, `Common.Cancel` in TGActionSheet.m:36-39 (drop the invented fallback chain), `Common.Done` for the TGSnackbar.m:173 default; add an `Common.Undo` key rather than a literal at :207.

findings.ours: TGSnackbar.m:145 falls back to a hand-mixed `colorWithRed:0.20 green:0.22 blue:0.24` flat plate when ConversationActionBar.png is missing.
findings.theirs: The original only ever draws this bar from the stretched PNG (`ConversationActionBar.png`, 40x110 px @2x = 20x55 pt) and has no flat-colour fallback anywhere; the value 0.20/0.22/0.24 appears nowhere in its source.
findings.citation: Telegraph/Telegraph/TGTelegraphConversationCompanion.mm:4868-4876 `image = [UIImage imageNamed:@"ConversationActionBar.png"];`; the asset is present unused-free at iTgLegacy/images/ConversationActionBar@2x.png
findings.fix: Drop the fallback branch in src/TGSnackbar.m:144-146; the asset ships in images/, so an eyeballed colour can only ever be wrong.
